example_sentences_in_bangla: বাবা ছেলেকে ভুলের জন্য মালিশ করলেন।
শিক্ষক ছাত্রকে মালিশ করে শিক্ষা দিলেন।
example_sentences_in_english: The father punished his son for the mistake by giving him a malish.
The teacher gave the student a malish to teach him a lesson.
note: This idiom derives from the literal act of massaging, figuratively implying a rough 'rubbing' or beating as punishment, common in everyday Bengali speech.
